title: segments.json
description: The market-map node's five disjoint search spaces, one per discovery node. Each is a business shape, not a category label: who buys, what they buy, in which market and language.

id.description: The discovery node's number: segment 1 is discover-1.

name.description: A short label for the space, used in logs only.

shape.description: Who the buyer is, what is bought, and what the contract is for.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the market's own language, the language the queries are written in.

queries.description: Search queries for this shape, disjoint from every other segment's.

why.description: The job ad or client page line this space rests on, quoted.
